$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.common.naming. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-NAMING-SKIPSCAN-REPORT-INDEX
arms.find: final unreadable: Array<String> = resolutionIndex.text.skippedFilesMentioning([decl.name, ownerName, targetName], declFile);
arms.note: the cross-file rename asks the REPORT index about unreadable files again, so a skip-parsing project module outside the lint scope stops refusing a rename it can invalidate

arms.name: M-CONFINEMENT-REPORT-INDEX-RENAME
arms.note: the single-file rename asks the REPORT index for confinement again, so an `@:access` grantee outside the lint scope is invisible, the member reads as confined and the rename rewrites the declaring file alone — orphaning the grantee's access. Cuts the ARGUMENT rather than the local since S180: the local `wideIndex` now feeds the reflection scan beside it, and an arm that cut it would disable two proofs at once

arms.name: M-REFLECTION-REPORT-INDEX-RENAME
arms.find: for (entry in ReflectionScan.scopeFiles(index == null ? [] : indexSources(index), plugin)) if (entry.file != currentFile) {
arms.replace: for (entry in (index == null ? [] : indexSources(index))) if (entry.file != currentFile) {
arms.note: the cross-file reflection guard walks the REPORT index alone again instead of the shared scope seam, so a `Reflect.field(x, 'name')` in a file the run does not lint contributes no name, the guard has nothing to refuse on and the single-file rename orphans the reflective read

arms.name: M-GATE-NOOP-UNDERSCORE
arms.note: no-underscore-prefix exempting params and locals is reported as running

arms.name: M-SHADOWING-BINDER-UNPROVEN
arms.find: if (!CasePatternScan.provesCapture(seams, root, switchNode, arm, binder, scope)) continue;
arms.note: a binder that may compare against a constant is reported as a catch-all

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-NO-CANDIDATE
arms.note: no finding is ever a privatize candidate, so the public `_x` nothing outside reads is renamed again

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-METHOD-CANDIDATE
arms.note: a method is a candidate too, though its visibility answers to overrides and interfaces

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-NO-UNDERSCORE
arms.note: a public field without the private marker is a candidate under a policy whose private rule admits it

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-NOT-PUBLIC
arms.note: a field already private is a candidate, whose `public` keyword does not exist

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-NO-OWNER
arms.note: a declaration with no enclosing type is a candidate

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-IMPLICIT-REACH
arms.note: an annotated / registry member some mechanism reaches without a written reference is privatized

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-RENAME-UNSAFE
arms.note: a member the grammar marks rename-unsafe (accessor property, @:rtti, structure field) is privatized

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-RULE-UNCHECKED
arms.note: a field the private rule would still flag (`_Label`, a static) is privatized and keeps its finding

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-INCOMPLETE-PROJECT
arms.note: the arm runs on a report set that is not the whole project — the lint-fix-scope incident shape

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-UNCERTAIN-RUN
arms.note: a modifier run only some builds see is privatized

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-TYPE-REACH
arms.note: a `@:keep` / `@:build` / extern type's field is privatized

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-CHAIN
arms.note: an unresolved supertype or an RTTI hierarchy does not refuse

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-AUTOBUILD-COUNTS
arms.note: an @:autoBuild ancestor refuses, so no openfl display class is ever privatized

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-ACCESS-GRANT
arms.note: an @:access grant naming the type does not refuse

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-FRAGMENT
arms.note: an interpolation fragment that may spell the name at runtime does not refuse

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-TOKENS-UNCHECKED
arms.find: if (PublicReach.occursOnlyWithin(name, ctx.tokens, regions, ctx.wide)) return keyword.span;
arms.note: an outside reader does not refuse

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-NO-SUBTYPE-REGION
arms.find: out.push({ file: sub.file.file, source: text, span: sub.type.span });
arms.note: a subtype's read refuses, though Haxe private is visible to a subclass

arms.name: M-NAMING-PRIVATIZE-NOT-DECLINED
arms.note: the rename runs over a finding the privatize arm owns

arms.name: M-NAMING-RISKYFIX-EMPTY
arms.note: the privatize arm writes nothing

arms.name: M-NAMING-RISKY-FINDINGS-ALL
arms.note: every naming finding is handed to the risky arm

arms.name: M-SHADOWING-LOCAL-NO-RENAME
arms.note: no shadow is renamed, so `final event:SidebarTabEvent` over an unread `event` parameter stays a finding although the rename is binder-proven

arms.name: M-SHADOWING-LOCAL-OUTER-READ-IGNORED
arms.note: a hidden binding read after the inner scope ends no longer keeps the finding, so the rule's own defect shape (a write meant for the outer) is renamed away and buried

arms.name: M-SHADOWING-LOCAL-NO-ASSIGNMENT
arms.note: a same-block `var` redeclaration of the same type is never turned into an assignment (client DatePicker dayIdx stays a finding)

arms.name: M-SHADOWING-LOCAL-CAPTURE-IGNORED
arms.note: a closure capturing the first binding does not stop the assignment, so the closure reads the redeclaration's value after the fix

arms.name: M-NAMING-PROPERTY-FACTS-NULL
arms.note: the naming projection gets no property facts, so every enum-abstract var / final stays a value

arms.name: M-NAMING-LOCAL-CROSS-NOTE
arms.note: the cross-file path writes its not-a-member sentence first on a local / parameter, burying the single-file path's collision reason

arms.name: M-NUP-DECLINE-SILENT
arms.note: a strip refused on a collision returns no edit and no reason

arms.name: M-NUP-SUPERSEDES-NONE
arms.note: no-underscore-prefix no longer replaces naming's finding on the same binding

arms.name: M-NAMING-CROSS-GRANTEES-DROPPED
arms.note: a granted member's rename stops at its own hierarchy and strands the grantee's access

arms.name: M-NAMING-FOREIGN-UNBOUND
arms.note: an unrelated class's own same-named private blocks a public rename and the privatize arm again

arms.name: M-NAMING-OUTSIDE-SCOPE-IGNORED
arms.note: a narrowed --fix renames a public member a project file outside the run still reads

arms.name: M-PRIVATIZE-FOREIGN-IGNORED
arms.note: the privatize arm counts an unrelated class's own same-named private as a read of the member

arms.name: M-NAMING-FOREIGN-LOSES-TO-BARE
arms.find: for (s in refs.bareBound) if (!OccurrenceScan.offsetWithinAny(s.from, foreign)) s
arms.note: a subtype's same-named parameter read is renamed into the inherited field: `super.setup(accountScreen)` becomes `super.setup(_accountScreen)`, which compiles

arms.name: M-XRENAME-NOT-CANDIDATE
arms.note: no type or enum value reaches the cross-file rename arm

arms.name: M-XRENAME-FINDINGS-NONE
arms.note: the verifier is handed no finding of the cross-file arm

arms.name: M-XRENAME-EDITS-DROPPED
arms.note: the engine's edits never reach the edit set

arms.name: M-XRENAME-INDEXED-UNDERLYING
arms.note: an implicit Int value is refused as if it were its name

arms.name: M-XRENAME-RUNTIME-TYPE
arms.note: a class is renamed although its name exists at run time

arms.name: M-XRENAME-MAIN-TYPE
arms.note: a module main type is renamed without its file

arms.name: M-XRENAME-TYPE-META
arms.note: a type carrying @:native / @:keep is renamed

arms.name: M-XRENAME-SAFE-META
arms.note: an inert @:forward refuses the rename

arms.name: M-XRENAME-GUARDED
arms.note: a type only one build sees is renamed

arms.name: M-XRENAME-ENUM-CTOR
arms.note: a plain enum constructor is treated as an enum-abstract value

arms.name: M-XRENAME-STRING
arms.note: a literal naming the declaration does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-TYPE-PATH
arms.note: a Type.resolveClass path literal does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-OLD-SHARED
arms.note: a second declaration of the old type name does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-NEW-DECLARED
arms.note: a library type of the new name does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-NEW-SPELLED
arms.note: a project reference already spelling the new name does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-VALUE-OLD-SHARED
arms.note: another enum value of the old name does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-VALUE-NEW-SHARED
arms.note: another enum value of the new name does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-VALUE-PROPERTY
arms.note: an enum abstract property of the old name refuses as if it were a value

arms.name: M-XRENAME-VALUE-BOUND
arms.note: a binding of the new name in a file the rename edits does not refuse

arms.name: M-XRENAME-OUTSIDE
arms.note: a narrowed run edits a project file outside its scope

arms.name: M-XRENAME-VALUE-META
arms.note: a value carrying metadata is renamed

arms.name: M-XRENAME-NO-PROJECT
arms.note: the arm runs without the whole project indexed

arms.name: M-XRENAME-STRING-TYPES-ONLY
arms.note: a literal spelling an enum-abstract value's name (data) refuses its rename

arms.name: M-NAMING-READONLY-IGNORES-WRITE
arms.note: a `(get, set)` property reads as read-only, so a public static one takes the constant format

arms.name: M-SHADOWING-PARAM-NO-RENAME
arms.find: if (site.seams.reportParameters) return renameEdits(site, decl, name, span, path[path.length - 2]);
arms.note: no shadowing parameter is renamed, so `(item:DiskSystemItemData) -> …` over a local `item` stays a finding although the rename is binder-proven

arms.name: M-NAMING-HANDLER-OVERRIDE
arms.note: an override of a supertype onX listener is reported as a name the project chose
